item.title: Yesteryear
item.description: I have GOT to stop reading books recommended by random people on the internet. This was one was recommended by New York Times, I think - or at least somewhere online. I don’t think reading this book was an active decision I made, I saw it mentioned and placed a hold at my local library. All this to say, I wouldn’t recommend it to anyone! Why Anne Hathaway agreed to star in its adaptation is beyond me!

item.title: Villa Coco
item.description: This book transported me to Italy! I read it with great interest thinking through two-thirds of the book. But the ending wasn’t fun. I found it was a slog to finish the last 100 or so pages. 10/10 for the environment of the book, tid bits of comedy, but otherwise I don’t know if I would recommend it to anyone else.
